scope: G6 native GPU resource-cache measurement; not a benchmark result, timeout fix or performance acceptance.
change: Count resource hits, misses, LRU evictions and first-image upload bytes. Resource capacity remains 64; rendering, ordering and cache policy are unchanged.
finding: The first 62 resources fit. Later accesses produce 132 evictions in 2701 draws, with 832197944 first-image upload bytes. This establishes turnover but does not prove it causes the original driver timeout. First-image bytes include required initial images, not only redundant texture reuploads. A changed policy needs bounded storage and an equal-work comparison.
validation: Original native 06 replay: zero renderer and PGRAPH faults
